<function name="Initialize" parent="GM" type="hook">
	<description>Called after the gamemode loads and starts.

No entities would be present at the time this hook is called, please see <page>GM:InitPostEntity</page> for a one time fire hook after all map entities have been initialized.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
</function>

<example>
	<description>"hi" will be printed to the console when the gamemode initializes.</description>
	<code>
function GM:Initialize()
	print( "hi" )
end

-- That way you are overriding the default hook.
-- You can use hook.Add to make more functions get called on initialization.
hook.Add( "Initialize", "some_unique_name", function()
	print( "Initialization hook called" )
end )
	</code>
	<output>`Initialization hook called` and `hi`</output>
</example>
